req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint must return HTTP 204 on success, HTTP 404 when the player does not exist, and handle edge cases like non-integer path parameters. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing player returns 204 and subsequent GET returns 404; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent squad number returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — delete squad number 1 (lowest in dataset) returns 204; (4) boundary BVA — delete squad number 26 (highest in dataset) returns 204; (5) STC — delete then re-delete same player returns 404 (state transition: exists -> deleted -> not-found); (6) NEG — delete with non-integer squad number returns 422; (7) DT — delete verifies response body is empty (204 No Content). Each test uses the in-process FastAPI TestClient and asserts exact status codes to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Kabir Mary Reddy)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert response.status_code == 204
    assert response.content == b''

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204()

tests.name: test_delete_mid_range_player_returns_204_and_collection_shrinks
preconditions: Player with squad_number=13 (Suresh Reyansh Iyer) exists in the database
actions: Send GET /players/ to count before deletion
Send GET /players/ to count after deletion
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_mid_range_player_returns_204_and_collection_shrinks():
    client = TestClient(app)
    before = client.get('/players/')
    assert before.status_code == 200
    count_before = len(before.json())
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/13')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    assert del_resp.content == b''
    after = client.get('/players/')
    assert after.status_code == 200
    count_after = len(after.json())
    assert count_after == count_before - 1

test_delete_mid_range_player_returns_204_and_collection_shrinks()
